title: Bold Words in String
summary: Given an array of keywords and a string, bold all instances of the keywords within the string.
statement: Given an array of keywords and a string, bold all instances of the keywords within the string. Use and tags to denote bold text, ensuring the fewest tags are used and the tags are valid.
constraints: Bold every character covered by an occurrence of any dictionary word.
Merge overlapping or adjacent bold regions into one tag pair.
Return the original text with lowercase HTML b tags inserted.
hints: Mark text positions covered by any matching word occurrence.
After marking, scan maximal consecutive true regions.
Emit ordinary characters directly and wrap each true run once.
The union of marked positions merges every overlap and adjacency without losing original text order.
editorial: The union of marked positions merges every overlap and adjacency without losing original text order.

tests.explanation: Occurrences overlap across abc, producing one merged bold region.
Two separated occurrences receive separate tag pairs.
